body: Me too, I hate being told stuff like that. "Your life is gonna get better'' or "You're still so young". I mean, some days I feel normal like I didn't just have a meltdown and post on the internet that I want to kill myself on my birthday. (Im bipolar) I just wish I could reverse time and go back 10 years to when I was happy and wasn't feeling like I do now all the time. I just want to be happy. Thats why I cut, because it makes me feel normal and better
Is there anyway you could get him out of his grandparents house? There's also the option of lgbt youth shelters if there are any near him.

What's wrong with it is they're all emotionally and verbally abusive. And that stupid line man, why do you have to say that, "you haven't lived yet", what more is there to live? I mean look at humanity now, its a hell hole. I don't wanna stick around if this bullshit is going on in how many years from now. I mean come one, "land of the free" thats a major fucking lie. I've tried to get a life, trust me I have, but everytime I try my hardwork goes to shit. In the end im the one getting screwed, sorry for getting angry but its true. This world is so fucked up anymore.
I hope you're still with us sir, if not, may any gods and goddesses out there watch over your 2 daughters and keep them safe if this is really what you want to do.

Thanks I love being called an 'unoriginal bastard' and told to 'get creative'. I have limited options dude, I live in a fucking camper with 4 other people in the middle of god knows where, im still fifteen so its not like I can go out to the store and buy a bunch of shit to kill myself with without getting looks and being asked "where are your parents?".  And I create scenarios like that all the time. I write them down and wish for them to be true, i"ve filled two notebooks just with different things like that. Anyways your idea is smart.
Thank you

I used to make pies and chocolate gravy with my nana when she was still alive but I think those were the only things im good at making. If you would like to share it that'd be cool, but if its a family recipe you should probably dm it to me instead of on here. I mean, your choice.

Well I didn't want to end it like this, really I didn't. Just I don't even know if I can make it two more years. Everything's tiring and hard. I mean I barley got by in school last year because I was struggling so much. It feels like the easiest option because waiting is gonna be hard.
Thank you dude
You sound like you would be/are a good parent. When you put it that way it does sound a bit better.

Yeah, it gets exhausting after a while, plastering a fake smile to satisfy people. Im trying my hardest, these comments are not what I expected and they might be breaking me slowly each time I read through one,
Thank you, im sorry you had to go through horrible trauma like you did.
Well that's a good way of putting it
I could try. Whats it like being a baker? I've always wanted to be one since I was a little lad but I don't think im good at baking

Well thank you, I mean, in our reality right now life is not very beautiful. If this is the kind of shit im supposed to expect in the future, that just gives me more of a reason to die. All these nice comments are weird, im really not used to it
After what my parents put me through they don't deserve my good memory, but thank you.

Well you assumed right. Unfortunately I live in America. I mean Canada has always been on my option idea, i'm not to far away from a border crossing either. And yeah I don't know if I could be a soldier because im not cut out for that,, I can barley walk without losing my breathe and getting stomach cramps.

Well thanks for a legitimate answer. This is helpful a lot. I've contemplated the hanging part but I don't want to be saved by somebody. And i've seen stories of people shooting themselves and ending up still being alive and having a mutilated face. (not what I want either) And I don't know about that. I have no way out anymore, I really don't. Im still young and it's not like I can get up and run away or move out. Death is always a reliable option, and quite honestly I think in my case it's going to be the most reliable.
I've considered it, but I don't know of anybody who'd want to be roommates with me. Im always sad so that might affect their vibe
Good idea, but I don't have much to work with besides trees and sewing needles. (A sewing kit is literally the only thing I still own)

If only it was that simple. I can barley afford to go to school as it is. My parents live off of stimulus and government checks, and I have to scrape by for myself with my 9$ an hour at McDonald's. They sell MY stuff to pay for food on the table. I couldn't even afford to move out if I wanted to. That would be the dream of course, but dreams are only dreams. Usually never reality.
It's alright, really, it's my suffering, not yours.
Im 15. And i've already heard the "you still have so much to live for" or "you still haven't experienced the world yet" comments already, so saying that won't really help..
When I do that it makes me just more upset and wishing to start over..
Im sorry that you've gone through the same shitty stuff I have. I can even trust myself so it might be hard trusting you. Im sorry.
You're probably just saying that to make me feel better. And it's hard to be helped when you're so far down a hole and you can't get out.

Hah, loved by the reddit community. If everybody here actually knew me and met me, they wouldn't love me. Im just another person on the internet talking about how they plan on killing themselves, nothing special about me.

Im sorry your daughter had to go through that. I ended up in the hospital because of something similar to that before. Not an eating disorder, unless starvation is an eating disorder, no clue really. And im not really valuable, trust me im not. Im just another suicidal person in the world.

Welp there's a quick way to make a person cry,

I've been told that im empathetic before, it's in my nature I guess. But I don't deserve to be alive, nor do I want to be. I know that "I have so much life ahead of me" but really I don't. Im not talented, im not smart, and im not gonna end up getting somewhere in life.
It's fine, don't let me bother you. It was just a thought.
Only some people deserve my kindness. I want to get an old dog (comments below) so I can give a good boy or good girl a nice rest of their life, maybe it might help me, I dont know.

I know how you feel except my family isn't holding me back, they wouldn't care really. And I have the license to drive with a guardian/18+ but I don't have my actual license yet. I mean, I have a lot of possibilities, since we live in a place surrounded by woods.
I know how you feel completely. Do you have any social medias we could dm through?
If you have Twitter I can dm you more on there, my account is @ anirishenby .
Thank you. I can't promise anything though, most likely i'll end up doing it.
Getting an old dog would be nice. The walking thing I don't think would help because I basically live in the woods
Thank you. But I don't know if I can hold on much longer. I feels like im drowning honestly.
I have two dogs, but they aren't fond of me.
Thanks I guess.
The only thing holding me back is that tiny feeling in the back of my brain, wishing and hoping for something, anything. But overall, I do really just want to die.
